MOD_CONST = 1000000007

class Matrix:
    def __init__(self, size):
        self.size = size
        self.data = [[0] * size for _ in range(size)]
        
    def __mul__(self, other):
        C = Matrix(self.size)
        for i in range(self.size):
            for j in range(self.size):
                total = 0
                for k in range(self.size):
                    total += self.data[i][k] * other.data[k][j]
                C.data[i][j] = total % MOD_CONST
        return C

def main():
    n_input, m_input = map(int, input().split())
    baseMat = Matrix(m_input + 1)
    identityMat = Matrix(m_input + 1)
    
    for i in range(m_input + 1):
        baseMat.data[i][i] = 1
        baseMat.data[0][i] = 1
        identityMat.data[i][i] = 1

    yVal = 1
    yPow = 1
    levelIdx = 0
    totalCount = 0

    while yPow * m_input <= n_input:
        yPow *= m_input
        levelIdx += 1

    biMatrices = [[Matrix(m_input + 1) for _ in range(m_input + 1)] for _ in range(levelIdx + 1)]
    for t in range(levelIdx + 1):
        if t > 0:
            biMatrices[t][0] = biMatrices[t - 1][0]
            for i in range(1, m_input + 1):
                biMatrices[t][0] = biMatrices[t][0] * biMatrices[t - 1][i]
        for i in range(1, m_input + 1):
            biMatrices[t][i] = biMatrices[t][i - 1]
            # Swap rows
            for j in range(m_input - 1):
                for k in range(m_input + 1):
                    biMatrices[t][i].data[j][k], biMatrices[t][i].data[j + 1][k] = biMatrices[t][i].data[j + 1][k], biMatrices[t][i].data[j][k]
            # Swap columns
            for j in range(m_input - 1):
                for k in range(m_input + 1):
                    biMatrices[t][i].data[k][j], biMatrices[t][i].data[k][j + 1] = biMatrices[t][i].data[k][j + 1], biMatrices[t][i].data[k][j]

    currentMat = identityMat
    while totalCount < n_input:
        if totalCount + yPow <= n_input:
            totalCount += yPow
            currentMat = currentMat * biMatrices[levelIdx][0]
            yVal = (yVal + 1) % m_input
        else:
            yPow //= m_input
            levelIdx -= 1

    finalSum = 0
    for i in range(m_input + 1):
        finalSum = (finalSum + currentMat.data[i][m_input]) % MOD_CONST
    print(finalSum)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
